captions.detailed: A wall-mounted swing-arm reading lamp featuring a black rectangular base plate, a two-part articulated black arm with gold-toned cylindrical joints, and a white conical lamp shade. The first link of the arm is connected to the wall mount via a vertical pivot joint, enabling horizontal rotation. The second link connects to the first with a matching gold-accented elbow joint, and the conical shade is mounted to the end of the second link with a tilt joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a wall-mounted swing-arm reading lamp. The lamp should feature a rectangular wall bracket, a two-link folding arm with cylindrical pivot joints, and a conical shade at the end. Apply a black finish to the bracket and arms, a gold metallic finish to the joint hardware, and a matte white color to the shade.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly starting with a rectangular box for the wall bracket. It then adds a first arm link (using a box/cylinder combination) via a revolute joint. A second arm link is attached to the first via an elbow revolute joint. Finally, a conical lamp shade, modeled by subtracting an inner cone from an outer cone, is attached to the second arm link via a third revolute joint.
